column1: #mapping_set_description: Unreviewed proposals of the mapping agent, prompt v1.

column8: author_label
column13: comment

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: The study participant number is the CDISC SUBJID concept; rejected NCIT:C69256 Subject Unique Identifier, which is the identifier unique across studies.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: The variable records the recruiting centre, i.e. the study site; rejected NCIT:C83081 Study Site Identifier because the description names the centre, not an identifier code.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Biological sex recorded at screening is the NCIT/CDISC Sex concept; rejected NCIT:C124436 Sex at Birth, which is the neonatal designation.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: NCIT Birth Year (synonym Year of Birth) is the year in which a person was born.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Years of formal education completed matches NCIT Number of Years of Education (EDUYRNUM); rejected NCIT:C17953 Education Level, which is categorical.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Dominant hand (R/L/both) is the NCIT Dominant Hand attribute; no handedness term exists in HPO.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Date of baseline enrolment matches NCIT Study Subject Enrolled Date (synonym Date of Enrollment); rejected NCIT:C164338 Age of Enrollment.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Date informed consent signed is the CDISC RFICDAT concept NCIT Informed Consent Date.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No NCIT term for family history of Parkinson disease in a first-degree relative exists, so the general Family Medical History term is broader; rejected MONDO:0005180 Parkinson disease because the participant's own diagnosis is not recorded.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: A clinical diagnosis of idiopathic PD is a diagnosis mapped to MONDO Parkinson disease; rejected MONDO:0021095 parkinsonian disorder as too broad and HP:0001300 Parkinsonism as a phenotype.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: MSA parkinsonian variant is MONDO multiple system atrophy, parkinsonian type (synonym MSA-p); rejected MONDO:0007803 multiple system atrophy as broader.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Clinical PSP diagnosis maps to MONDO progressive supranuclear palsy; rejected the PSP subtype syndromes such as MONDO:0009839 PSP-parkinsonism as narrower.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: MONDO Lewy body dementia carries the synonyms dementia with Lewy bodies and DLB; no separate DLB term was found.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: NCIT Age Symptom Started (synonym Age at Symptom Onset) covers any first symptom, so it is broader than age at first motor symptom; rejected NCIT:C124353 Symptom Onset, which is a time point, not an age.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: NCIT Age at Diagnosis is generic (defined for initial pathologic diagnosis), so it is broader than age at PD diagnosis; no PD-specific or clinical-diagnosis age term was found.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: A LRRK2 G2019S carrier status is related to the LRRK2 genetic disease PARK8 per the guidelines; rejected LOINC:82139-7, a targeted analysis of two variants (R1441G and G2019S) rather than the carrier status.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Bradykinesia on exam is a sign mapped to HPO Bradykinesia.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Rest tremor in any limb is HPO Resting tremor; rejected HP:0001337 Tremor as broader.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Rigidity on exam maps to HPO Rigidity; rejected HP:0007076 Extrapyramidal muscular rigidity and HP:0002396 Cogwheel rigidity because the variable does not specify the type.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Postural instability on the pull test is HPO Postural instability, whose definition cites the retropulsion test.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Freezing episodes when walking is HPO Freezing of gait.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Self-reported reduced sense of smell is the symptom HPO Hyposmia; rejected HP:0010635 Partial hyposmia as narrower.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No sense of smell is HPO Anosmia; rejected HP:0010632 Total anosmia as narrower and NCIT:C116369 because HPO takes precedence for symptoms.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Reported dream enactment is a symptom, so HPO REM sleep behavior disorder is used; rejected MONDO:0005937 REM sleep behavior disorder because the guidelines put symptoms in HPO.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Fewer than 3 bowel movements a week or laxative use defines the symptom HPO Constipation; rejected HP:0012450 Chronic constipation as narrower.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: A drop of at least 20/10 mmHg on standing is HPO Orthostatic hypotension; rejected HP:0004926 Orthostatic hypotension due to autonomic dysfunction as narrower.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Urinary urgency maps to HPO Urinary urgency.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: A clinician-judged diagnosis of depression is a disease diagnosis, so MONDO depressive disorder is used; rejected HP:0000716 Depression (symptom) and MONDO:0002009 major depressive disorder (narrower).

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Visual hallucinations in the last month is HPO Visual hallucination; rejected HP:0000738 Hallucinations as broader.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: PD-MCI by MDS Level II criteria is a subtype of mild cognitive impairment, and neither MONDO nor HPO has an MCI term; rejected HP:0100543 Cognitive impairment as more general still.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: HPO has no levodopa-induced dyskinesia term, so the broader HPO Dyskinesia is used; rejected HP:0040141 Tardive dyskinesia, which is neuroleptic-induced.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Difficulty swallowing is HPO Dysphagia.

column5: Movement Disorder Society Unified Parkinson's Disease Rating Scale Questionnaire
column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No LOINC or NCIT term exists for the MDS-UPDRS Part I total, so the MDS-UPDRS questionnaire is broader; rejected LOINC UPDRS codes, which are the original UPDRS.

column5: Movement Disorder Society Unified Parkinson's Disease Rating Scale Questionnaire
column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No LOINC or NCIT term exists for the MDS-UPDRS Part II total, so the MDS-UPDRS questionnaire is broader; rejected LOINC:77719-3, the original UPDRS ADL panel.

column5: Movement Disorder Society Unified Parkinson's Disease Rating Scale Questionnaire
column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No term exists for the MDS-UPDRS Part III total in the OFF state, so the MDS-UPDRS questionnaire is broader; rejected NCIT:C111615 UPDRS - Motor Examination Sub-total, which is the original UPDRS.

column5: Movement Disorder Society Unified Parkinson's Disease Rating Scale Questionnaire
column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No term exists for the MDS-UPDRS Part III total in the ON state, so the MDS-UPDRS questionnaire is broader; rejected NCIT:C111615 UPDRS - Motor Examination Sub-total, which is the original UPDRS.

column5: Movement Disorder Society Unified Parkinson's Disease Rating Scale Questionnaire
column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No term exists for the MDS-UPDRS Part IV total, so the MDS-UPDRS questionnaire is broader; rejected LOINC:77721-9, the original UPDRS complications panel.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Hoehn and Yahr rated in MDS-UPDRS III is NCIT MDS-UPDRS - Hoehn and Yahr Stage; rejected LOINC:77714-4 and NCIT:C100943, which are the modified Hoehn and Yahr of the original UPDRS.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: The MoCA total out of 30 is LOINC Total score [MoCA]; rejected LOINC:72133-2, the MoCA panel, and NCIT:C162720 because LOINC takes precedence.

column5: Geriatric depression scale (GDS) short version total
column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: The GDS-15 short form total is LOINC GDS short version total; rejected LOINC:48544-1, the 30-item GDS total.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No LOINC or NCIT term exists for the ESS total score, so the ESS questionnaire is the broader match.

column5: Scales for Outcomes in Parkinson's Disease - Autonomic Dysfunction Questionnaire
column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No LOINC or NCIT term exists for the SCOPA-AUT total score, so the SCOPA-AUT questionnaire is the broader match.

column5: Schwab England activities of daily living scale [UPDRS]
column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: The Schwab and England ADL % independence score is in LOINC, although it is coded within the original UPDRS panel; rejected NCIT:C111611 because LOINC takes precedence and LOINC:77716-9 because it is the with-dyskinesia rating.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No LOINC or NCIT term was found for the University of Pennsylvania Smell Identification Test; rejected NCIT:C17139 Olfaction and NCIT:C139027 Odor Detection as not this test.

column5: REM Sleep Behavior Disorder Screening Questionnaire
column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No LOINC or NCIT term exists for the RBDSQ total score, so the RBDSQ questionnaire is the broader match.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No LOINC code exists for an alpha-synuclein seed amplification assay result in CSF, so the analyte alpha-synuclein is related; rejected LOINC:49456-7, which is immunostaining in tissue.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Maximum ThT fluorescence (RFU) of the alpha-synuclein SAA is a relative-unit readout with no LOINC code, so it is related only to the analyte; rejected any concentration test and NCIT:C218853 Thioflavin T (the dye).

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No LOINC mass-concentration code exists for alpha-synuclein in CSF, so the NCIT protein is related per the guidelines; rejected NCIT:C142272 Alpha Synuclein Protein Measurement and LOINC:49456-7 (tissue immunostain).

column5: Amyloid beta 42 peptide [Mass/volume] in Cerebrospinal Fluid
column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Amyloid beta 1-42 in CSF in pg/mL agrees with this code on component, CSF specimen and mass/volume property; rejected the plasma code LOINC:33200-7.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Total tau in CSF in pg/mL matches this code on component, specimen and mass/volume, with no method stated; rejected LOINC:101649-2, which adds an immunoassay method the variable does not state.

column5: Phosphorylated tau 181 [Mass/volume] in Cerebrospinal Fluid by Immunoassay
column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Phospho-tau 181 in CSF by immunoassay in pg/mL agrees with this code on component, specimen, mass/volume and method; rejected the plasma code LOINC:103675-5.

column5: Neurofilament light chain [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma by Immunoassay
column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Serum NfL by Simoa (an immunoassay) in pg/mL matches this Ser/Plas mass/volume immunoassay code; rejected LOINC:112614-3, which is moles/volume in plasma.

column5: Neurofilament light chain [Moles/volume] in Plasma by Immunoassay
column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Plasma NfL in pmol/L requires a moles/volume code, and this is the plasma one; rejected LOINC:101281-4, which is mass/volume.

column5: Neurofilament light chain [Mass/volume] in Cerebrospinal Fluid
column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: CSF NfL in ng/L is mass/volume in CSF and matches this code.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: A SomaScan RFU value has no LOINC code and is never a concentration test, so it is related to the NCIT GPNMB protein; rejected NCIT:C113114 GPNMB Gene.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: An Olink NPX value has no LOINC code and is never a concentration test, so it is related to the NCIT GPNMB protein; rejected NCIT:C113114 GPNMB Gene.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: An Olink Explore NPX value for cathepsin B has no LOINC code, so it is related to the NCIT Cathepsin B protein; rejected NCIT:C28405 CTSB Gene.

column5: C reactive protein [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma by High sensitivity method
column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Serum high-sensitivity CRP in mg/L matches this code on component, specimen, mass/volume and high-sensitivity method; rejected LOINC:1988-5, which has no high-sensitivity method.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Serum uric acid in umol/L requires the moles/volume code; rejected LOINC:3084-1, which is mass/volume.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: HbA1c as % of total haemoglobin is the mass fraction in blood with no method stated; rejected LOINC:17856-6 (by HPLC) and LOINC:41995-2 (mass/volume).

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Red cell count in CSF per uL is the number concentration with no method stated; rejected LOINC:792-2 (manual count) and LOINC:791-4 (automated count).

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: Fasted more than 8 h before the blood draw (y/n) is the fasting status at specimen collection; rejected NCIT:C93566 Fasting Status Indicator and NCIT:C120460 Fasting Status as less specific to the draw.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No NCIT term was found for the number of freeze-thaw cycles of a specimen; rejected NCIT:C158280 Thawed Specimen and NCIT:C48165 Thaw as not a count.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No NCIT or LOINC term was found for DaT-SPECT specific binding ratio in the putamen; rejected NCIT:C95006 Binding Potential and NCIT:C12452 Putamen as different concepts.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No NCIT or LOINC term was found for DaT-SPECT specific binding ratio in the caudate; rejected NCIT:C95006 Binding Potential and NCIT:C12451 Caudate Nucleus as different concepts.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: The assay plate or batch identifier matches NCIT Assay Plate Identifier; rejected NCIT:C104504 Batch Number, a manufacturing lot.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: No NCIT term exists for levodopa equivalent daily dose, so the general Daily Dose is broader; rejected NCIT:C611 Levodopa because LEDD sums all antiparkinsonian drugs.

column8: Mapping agent v1 (Claude Code agent, claude-opus-5-5)
column13: ON/OFF at the motor exam is the MDS-UPDRS Part III clinical-state item; rejected NCIT:C100538 MDS-UPDRS - Time Spent in the Off State.
